image_description: A side-profile view of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming in an aquarium environment. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, contrasting with a bright yellow posterior body and tail. A distinct yellow vertical bar separates the black and yellow regions on the flank. The background consists of blurred purple and grey coral structures.
